meta.name: dev-verify
meta.description: Verify that a change really works before claiming completion. Use when the user wants confidence that a feature, fix, or refactor actually works — turns vague "it should work" claims into concrete evidence. Pairs with @oath-verifier agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证改动是否真正生效，避免空口承诺
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在声称完成前确认改动确实有效
copy.tagline_en: Verify changes actually work before claiming completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need concrete evidence that a change works before calling it done

howto.what: 装此技能后，Claude 在声称改动完成前会先验证是否有效，用测试或命令检查，并报告通过/失败，避免说“应该可以”。
howto.when: 当用户要求确认某个功能、修复或重构确实有效时触发。

say.text: 验证这个 bug 修复真的生效了吗？
say.note: Claude 会运行相关测试或命令来检查。

say.text: 检查我刚加的排序功能是否工作正常。
say.note: 它会按优先级执行验证并输出证据。

say.text: 测试这个重构有没有引入新错误。
say.note: 它会运行现有测试并报告结果。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude verifies that a change actually works before claiming completion—using tests or direct commands, and reports pass/fail instead of saying "it should work."
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants confidence that a feature, fix, or refactor actually works.

say_en.text: Verify if this bug fix is actually effective.
say_en.note: Claude will run relevant tests or commands to check.

say_en.text: Check if my newly added sorting function works correctly.
say_en.note: It will prioritize verification steps and output evidence.

say_en.text: Test if this refactoring introduces any new errors.
say_en.note: It will run existing tests and report results.
